abstain_reason: Candidate-point toolchain defect, not absence of visual evidence. propose_points returned v1:p7 at (98,169) and v1:p2 at (242,159) on the outer top-left and top-right bezel corners of the widescreen monitor (implying an outer width near 0.51 m, range 0.45-0.58 m), but agent_client.py runs each subcommand in a fresh process and Session.persist_usage() is only called inside consume_visual/next_view_id, i.e. before register_points populates point_registry; the registry was therefore never written to mcp_out/state/nyuv2_0551.usage.json (status reports points: []). Submitting p1/p2 by point_id now fails POINT_ID_UNKNOWN, and the 4/4 observation budget is exhausted so points cannot be re-proposed; the candidate-point condition cannot express this anchor until the client persists the registry after propose_points.
